description: vector graphics is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Wind geographical potentials > CORINE", published or maintained by eea.europa.eu (publisher inferred from the link). CORINE 2006 has European land coverage down to 100m x100m sourced on satellite sensing (i.e. not just photos) CORINE contains classification of land cover (agriculture, pasture, wetlands,etc) but NOT usage (i.e. natural park) both as raster (TIF raster with geographic projection) and as vector graphics (i.e. polygons for each land coverage type). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Wind geographical potentials" lists it under "CORINE". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wind potential inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
